Huisvestingsverordening Zuid-Kennemerland/IJmond: Beverwijk 2026 is current.
Opkoopbescherming applies specifically to qualifying dwellings in Wijk aan Zee with a value up to 120% of the NHG limit and qualifying acquisition/use circumstances.
The protected period is four years and the regulation contains permit, waiver, exclusion and evidence rules.
Because the regime is geographically limited, exact address resolution to Wijk aan Zee is mandatory.
Current 2026 tourist-tax regulation confirms municipal treatment of holiday/recreational accommodation but is not itself permission for residential tourist rental.

The current 2026 leges regulation explicitly provides a fee for a verhuurvergunning opkoopbescherming and references the Bloemendaal housing regulation framework.

This is strong current evidence that the opkoopbescherming permit product remains operational, but the underlying current substantive articles must still be fetched and validated before encoding thresholds/areas/exceptions.
